name: WhatsApp
tagline: World's largest private messenger, now monetising businesses, Channels and Status
facts: Not split; Meta other rev $1.0B Q2'26 (+73%)

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Simple, reliable, private messaging and calling for everyone, anywhere in the world.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Become the default way people talk to businesses, creators and AI, not just friends and family.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Keep Chats free, ad-free and encrypted; monetise businesses via paid messaging, Click-to-WhatsApp ads and Updates tab ads.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Phone-number graph and network effects; default app in India, Brazil, Indonesia; works on low-end phones and weak networks.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: Business AI agents and Meta AI in chats; India commerce and payments under Kunal Shah after $900M CRED stake.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Can WhatsApp scale Status ads and AI agents without breaking the private, ad-free promise that built it?

customers.who: 3B+ people chatting with family and groups
customers.pain: Need free, reliable, private messaging and calls across countries and networks
customers.why: Everyone they know is already there; free calls; E2EE; works on cheap phones

customers.who: Shops, tutors, clinics using Business app
customers.pain: Need a cheap way to reach customers, share catalogues, take orders
customers.why: Free app, customers already on it, catalogues and quick replies replace a website

customers.who: Banks, airlines, D2C brands via Business Platform
customers.pain: SMS and email get ignored; need verified, rich, two-way customer channel
customers.why: High open rates, green tick trust, APIs via BSPs, AI agents automate support

customers.who: Brands buying CTWA and Status ads
customers.pain: Need leads that convert into real conversations, not cheap clicks
customers.why: Meta targeting plus chat handoff; Status ads reach 1.5B+ daily Updates-tab users (est.)

customers.pain: Need a broadcast audience and a way to monetise followers
customers.why: Massive reach, promoted channels for discovery, paid channel subscriptions

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Meta 'other revenue' hit $1.0B in Q2'26 (+73%), mostly WhatsApp paid messaging and subscriptions; CTWA sits inside the $59B ads line.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: 3B+ users pay nothing; businesses and advertisers pay. Chats stay ad-free and encrypted, so ads live only in Updates.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Near-zero marginal cost per message; service replies free within 24 hours; utility rates tiered by volume to drive adoption.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Scale Status ads, paid AI agents, payments and commerce in India and Brazil, more enterprise utility traffic moving off SMS.

bullets.label: Lesson
bullets.text: Monetise the side of the network that gets ROI (businesses) and protect the side that creates the network effect.

friction: Marketing message overload from brands feels like spam
Status ads clutter a previously ad-free Updates tab
Forwarded misinformation spreads fast in large groups
Phone number exposure until usernames fully roll out
Old Android phones dropped in Sep 2026
